answer_4.guideline: The annotators undertook extensive, iterative schema design sessions in consultation with a subject matter expert in reproducibility of SBS experiments. After the schema was settled on pilot examples, a lead annotator established the annotation standards on several hundred examples through a process of relabeling and retraining the suggestion model.
